caption:
Amakazaam! from Amazon, rocking out in flannel, bring Alanis Morissette's You Oughta Know to the Manning Bar. The Sydney 2026 runners-up earned the judges' top performance score of the night. It's the second song we've released from their set, after Under Pressure.

Video shot by @sailornicole and @demonrace, with photos and video sponsored by V2 AI.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to @youngcareoz, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
